messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled and starting rollout
- env: dedicated-us-west-2 (private)
- release tag: release/v2.4.0-rc1
- commit: 9f3b2a1 (compare: 6a7d4c2)
- change window: 2026-03-20 22:00-23:00 UTC
- rollout plan: canary 10% -> 30% -> 100% (auto-promote if health ok)
Start time: 2026-03-20T22:03:20Z
Status: canary (10%)

melissa: 👍 watching metrics (p95, error_rate)

sam: seeing a small tail latency bump on canary node canary-3 at ~22:05
```
[22:05:12] request id=8a2 error_rate=0.9% latency=120ms
[22:05:37] request id=8a9 error_rate=2.7% latency=420ms
[22:06:01] request id=9b1 error_rate=3.1% latency=510ms
```

ops-oncall: paging ivan — @ivan can you grab infra logs for canary-3?

ivan: on it. pulling kube events + dmesg. no OOMs. node kernel logs show repeated GPU driver WARN around 22:04. attaching snippet:
```
Mar 20 22:04:58 canary-3 kernel: nvidia: GPU reset detected on GPU 0
Mar 20 22:05:00 canary-3 kernel: nvidia: GPU recovery succeeded
Mar 20 22:05:01 canary-3 application: model-infer: warn: slow step: 410ms
```

melissa: that aligns with the latency spikes. threshold for canary health is error_rate <= 1.5% and p95 <= 250ms. we're above both.

deploy-bot: Canary health check FAILED
- metric: error_rate=2.4% (threshold 1.5%)
- metric: p95=472ms (threshold 250ms)
- affected route: /v1/generate (dedicated-us-west-2/canary)
Recommended action: pause rollout and rollback canary to previous stable tag release/v2.3.9
Current status: rollout paused, awaiting operator decision

jorge: I support rollback. don't risk promoting. pin dedicated-us-west-2 to v2.3.9 while we triage.

sam: +1 rollback. I'll capture traces and a failing request sample for the infra/rt team.

deploy-bot: Executing rollback on canary pool...
- command: ```kubectl -n redwood serving set image deploy=redwood/serve:release-v2.3.9 --selector=pool=canary```
- initiating pod restarts for canary-3, canary-4

deploy-bot: Rollback complete for canary group.
- canary nodes now running tag release/v2.3.9
- verified health checks: error_rate=0.4% p95=140ms
- time completed: 2026-03-20T22:09:35Z

melissa: thanks. creating INF-1234: "v2.4.0-rc1 canary latency/regression investigation" and assigning to eng-ml + eng-runtime.

ivan: opened infra ticket INF-1235 for GPU driver warnings on canary-3. I'll schedule a maintenance reimage for the node tomorrow morning.

jorge: we'll reschedule the RC after root cause and a staged repro in staging. keeping change window open but aborting auto-promote.

deploy-bot: Final note: rollout aborted. dedicated-us-west-2 pinned to release/v2.3.9. Next steps: triage in staging, reproduce with load harness, consider a smaller binary build and driver compatibility test before reattempting.

melissa: cc @product (FYI) — postponing feature window until regression cleared :wave:
